lines.text: 엄마가 빨간 모자에게 말했어요. "할머니가 아프시단다. 맛있는 걸 가져다 드리렴."
lines.en: Mother said to Little Red Riding Hood. Grandmother is sick. Bring her something yummy.
segs: Mother said to Little Red Riding Hood.
Grandmother is sick. Bring her something yummy.

lines.text: 빵, 우유, 사과를 바구니에 담아요!
lines.en: Put the bread, milk, and apple in the basket!

lines.text: 셋! 바구니가 가득 찼어요.
lines.en: Three! The basket is full.

lines.text: 엄마가 빨간 모자를 머리에 씌워 주었어요. 빨간 모자가 한 번 빙글 돌았어요.
lines.en: Mother put the red hood on her head. Red Hood spun around once.

lines.text: "길에서 벗어나면 안 돼. 모르는 사람과 이야기하지도 마."
lines.en: Don't leave the path. And don't talk to strangers.
segs: Don't leave the path. And don't talk to strangers.

lines.text: "네, 엄마! 약속해요."
lines.en: Yes, Mother! I promise.

lines.text: 엄마와 빨간 모자는 새끼손가락을 걸었어요.
lines.en: Mother and Red Hood hooked their little fingers together.

lines.text: 빨간 모자는 콧노래를 부르며 숲길을 걸어요. 빨간 모자를 톡톡 눌러서 걸어가 봐요!
lines.en: Red Hood hummed as she walked along the forest path. Tap, tap Red Hood to walk along!

lines.text: 어, 나무 뒤에서 뭔가 보슬보슬한 게 살짝 보였어요. 꼬리였나 봐요!
lines.en: Oh, something fluffy peeked out from behind a tree. It must be a tail!

lines.text: 나무 옆에서 늑대가 슬그머니 나왔어요. "빨간 모자 아가씨, 어디 가니?"
lines.en: The wolf slipped out from beside a tree. Little Red Riding Hood, where are you going?
segs: The wolf slipped out from beside a tree.
Little Red Riding Hood, where are you going?

lines.text: "할머니 댁에 가요." 빨간 모자가 대답했어요.
lines.en: I'm going to Grandmother's house. Red Hood answered.

lines.text: "꽃을 따 가면 할머니가 참 좋아하실 텐데~"
lines.en: Grandmother would love it if you picked some flowers~
segs: Grandmother would love it if you picked some flowers~

lines.text: "좋은 생각이에요!" 빨간 모자는 엄마와 한 약속을 깜빡하고 말았어요.
lines.en: What a good idea! Red Hood forgot her promise to Mother.
segs: Red Hood forgot her promise to Mother.

lines.text: 꽃밭에 알록달록 꽃이 가득해요. 꽃을 같은 색 꽃병에 쏙쏙 담아요!
lines.en: The flower field is full of colorful flowers. Put each flower in the vase of the same color!

lines.text: 꽃병마다 꽃다발이 활짝! 빨간 모자는 꽃을 따느라 시간 가는 줄 몰랐어요.
lines.en: Bouquets in every vase! Red Hood was so busy picking flowers, she lost track of time.

lines.text: 위에서는 빨간 모자가 꽃을 따요. 아래에서는 늑대가 지름길로 달려가요!
lines.en: Up above, Red Hood picks flowers. Down below, the wolf runs along the shortcut!

lines.text: 똑똑똑… 문이 닫히고… 꿀꺽!
lines.en: Knock, knock, knock... the door closes... gulp!

lines.text: 늑대는 할머니의 잠옷을 입고 침대에 누웠어요.
lines.en: The wolf put on Grandmother's nightgown and lay down in her bed.

lines.text: 빨간 모자는 숲속 할머니 집에 도착했어요. 문을 톡 두드려요!
lines.en: Red Hood arrived at Grandmother's house in the forest. Tap to knock on the door!

lines.text: "들어오렴~" 안에서 쉰 목소리가 들렸어요.
lines.en: Come in~ A hoarse voice came from inside.
segs: A hoarse voice came from inside.

lines.text: "할머니, 오셨어요?" 그런데 침대 속 할머니가 어딘가 이상해요.
lines.en: Grandmother, are you here? But Grandmother in the bed looked a little odd.
segs: But Grandmother in the bed looked a little odd.

lines.text: 벽에 걸린 진짜 할머니 사진과 비교해서 다른 곳을 찾아봐요!
lines.en: Compare with the real Grandmother's picture on the wall and find what is different!

lines.text: 빨간 모자는 고개를 갸웃했어요. 또 이상한 곳이 있나 봐요.
lines.en: Red Hood tilted her head. There must be something else odd.

lines.text: 빨간 모자는 깜짝 놀랐어요. 이 사람은 할머니가 아니에요!
lines.en: Red Hood was startled. This is not Grandmother!

lines.text: 늑대가 벌떡 일어났어요! 빨간 모자야, 어서 숨어요! 옷장을 톡!
lines.en: The wolf jumped up! Red Hood, hide quickly! Tap the wardrobe!

lines.text: 빨간 모자는 옷장 속으로 쏙! 늑대는 두리번두리번 찾았지만 보이지 않았어요.
lines.en: Red Hood slipped into the wardrobe! The wolf looked all around but could not see her.

lines.text: 할머니를 먹어서 배가 불렀던 늑대는 스르르 눈이 감겼어요. 쿨쿨…
lines.en: The wolf was full from eating Grandmother, and his eyes slowly closed. Zzz...

lines.text: 창밖으로 지나가던 사냥꾼이 코 고는 소리를 들었어요. 창문을 톡톡 두드려 봐요!
lines.en: A hunter passing by the window heard the snoring. Tap, tap on the window!

lines.text: "이상한 코골이네? 할머니 댁에 무슨 일이 있나?" 사냥꾼이 방 안으로 들어왔어요.
lines.en: What a strange snore! Is something wrong at Grandmother's house? The hunter came into the room.
segs: What a strange snore! Is something wrong at Grandmother's house?
The hunter came into the room.

lines.text: "늑대잖아! 이럴 땐 간질간질 간지럼이 최고지!"
lines.en: It's a wolf! At a time like this, a tickle is the best!
segs: It's a wolf! At a time like this, a tickle is the best!

lines.text: 늑대가 딸꾹! 하자 할머니가 퐁! 하고 튀어나왔어요. 할머니는 다치지 않고 멀쩡했어요!
lines.en: The wolf hiccupped, hic! and Grandmother popped out, pop! Grandmother was not hurt at all!

lines.text: 늑대는 깜짝 놀라서 "걸음아 날 살려라~" 하고 창밖으로 달아났어요.
lines.en: The wolf was so startled that Run for your life! and he ran away out the window.
segs: The wolf was so startled that
and he ran away out the window.

lines.text: 빨간 모자도 옷장에서 살그머니 나왔어요. "할머니!"
lines.en: Red Hood crept out of the wardrobe too. Grandma!
segs: Red Hood crept out of the wardrobe too.

lines.text: 할머니 집 식탁에서 모두 함께 차를 마셔요. 바구니 속 간식을 한 가지씩 나눠 줘요!
lines.en: Everyone has tea together at Grandmother's table. Share a snack from the basket with each one!

lines.text: "모두 고마워요!" 할머니는 활짝 웃었어요.
lines.en: Thank you, everyone! Grandmother smiled brightly.

lines.text: "이제 약속을 꼭 지킬게요. 길에서 벗어나지 않고, 모르는 사람과는 이야기하지 않을래요."
lines.en: I'll keep my promise now. I won't leave the path, and I won't talk to strangers.
segs: I'll keep my promise now. I won't leave the path, and I won't talk to strangers.

lines.text: 빨간 모자는 새끼손가락을 걸고, 오늘 일을 오래오래 기억했어요.
lines.en: Red Hood hooked her little finger again, and remembered today for a long, long time.

lines.text: 톡! 바구니에 담아요.
lines.en: Tap! Put it in the basket.

lines.text: 빨간 모자를 톡! 새끼손가락을 걸어요.
lines.en: Tap Red Hood! Hook your little finger.

lines.text: 빨간 모자를 톡톡톡! 한 걸음씩 걸어가요.
lines.en: Tap, tap, tap Red Hood! Walk one step at a time.

lines.text: 꽃이랑 색깔이 같은 꽃병이 어디 있을까?
lines.en: Where is the vase with the same color as the flower?

lines.text: 빨간 모자를 톡! 똑똑똑 노크해요.
lines.en: Tap Red Hood! Knock, knock, knock.

lines.text: "할머니, 귀가 왜 이렇게 커요?"
lines.en: Grandmother, why are your ears so big?
segs: Grandmother, why are your ears so big?

lines.text: "네 말을 잘 들으려고 그렇지~"
lines.en: All the better to hear you with~
segs: All the better to hear you with~

lines.text: "할머니, 눈이 왜 이렇게 노랗고 커요?"
lines.en: Grandmother, why are your eyes so big and yellow?
segs: Grandmother, why are your eyes so big and yellow?

lines.text: "너를 잘 보려고 그렇지~"
lines.en: All the better to see you with~
segs: All the better to see you with~

lines.text: "할머니, 입이 왜 이렇게 길어요?"
lines.en: Grandmother, why is your mouth so long?
segs: Grandmother, why is your mouth so long?

lines.text: "그건 말이지… 어흥! 놀랐지?"
lines.en: Well, you see... Roar! Did I scare you?
segs: Well, you see... Roar! Did I scare you?

lines.text: 사진 속 할머니와 달라 보이는 곳을 톡!
lines.en: Tap what looks different from Grandmother in the picture!

lines.text: 이불 말고, 얼굴을 자세히 봐요.
lines.en: Not the blanket. Look closely at the face.

lines.text: 얼굴에서 이상한 곳을 눌러 봐요!
lines.en: Tap the odd part of the face!

lines.text: 옷장을 톡! 쏙 숨어요.
lines.en: Tap the wardrobe! Pop in and hide.

lines.text: 창문을 톡!
lines.en: Tap the window!

lines.text: 늑대를 톡톡톡! 간지럼을 태워요.
lines.en: Tap, tap, tap the wolf! Tickle him.

lines.text: 간식을 톡! 한 사람씩 나눠 줘요.
lines.en: Tap the snack! Share with each one.

lines.text: 빨간 모자를 톡! 다시 약속해요.
lines.en: Tap Red Hood! Promise again.

lines.text: 빨간 꽃이에요! 같은 색 꽃병을 톡!
lines.en: A red flower! Tap the vase of the same color!

lines.text: 빨간 꽃병이에요! 반짝이는 꽃병을 눌러 봐요!
lines.en: A red vase! Tap the sparkling vase!

lines.text: 노란 꽃이에요! 같은 색 꽃병을 톡!
lines.en: A yellow flower! Tap the vase of the same color!

lines.text: 노란 꽃병이에요! 반짝이는 꽃병을 눌러 봐요!
lines.en: A yellow vase! Tap the sparkling vase!

lines.text: 파란 꽃이에요! 같은 색 꽃병을 톡!
lines.en: A blue flower! Tap the vase of the same color!

lines.text: 파란 꽃병이에요! 반짝이는 꽃병을 눌러 봐요!
lines.en: A blue vase! Tap the sparkling vase!

lines.text: 빵은 할머니께 톡!
lines.en: Bread goes to Grandmother. Tap!

lines.text: 우유는 빨간 모자 톡!
lines.en: Milk goes to Red Hood. Tap!

lines.text: 사과는 사냥꾼 아저씨 톡!
lines.en: Apple goes to Mr. Hunter. Tap!
